title: OCaml Temporal native client signal request
description: Closed JSON document used only by the private Rust client bridge. The request names one exact workflow run or, with an empty run_id, the current run, carries a stable signal request ID, and preserves the ordered payload list. Runtime validators also reject duplicate keys, NUL bytes, and identifiers or payload metadata keys over the 65,536-byte safety limit. Payload data follows the start-input bounds: at most 128 MiB per decoded byte field within the 192 MiB document limit.

run_id.description: Exact run ID, or the empty string to select the workflow's current run, which Temporal resolves when it handles the request (#791).
